overview: The Agafay Desert is a stone desert about 40 km southwest of Marrakech, a drive of around 45 minutes. It has no sand dunes. Instead it is a landscape of bare, pale hills, and on clear evenings the High Atlas peaks stand along the southern horizon.

You are collected in the afternoon at a time set by the season, so that you reach the camp about an hour before sunset. After mint tea, you ride a camel across the hills for about an hour, dressed in a scarf and robe if you like, and stop at a high point to watch the sun go down over the Atlas.

Back at camp, dinner is served under the tents or outside: soup, salads, tagine and fruit, followed by music around the fire. You return to Marrakech around 21:30 to 22:30. It is the shortest way to see a desert landscape if you do not have the 3 days needed for the Sahara.

program.title: Afternoon pickup in Marrakech
program.description: Your driver collects you at your hotel or the nearest vehicle-accessible gate. Pickup is earlier in winter and later in summer so you arrive before sunset. You head southwest past the Lalla Takerkoust reservoir.

program.title: Welcome at the desert camp
program.description: Mint tea at the camp after about 45 minutes on the road. You can borrow a scarf and robe for the camel ride.

program.title: Sunset camel ride
program.description: A ride of about one hour across the stone hills, ending at a viewpoint where you watch the sun set over the High Atlas. Quad biking can replace or be added to the ride for an extra fee.

program.title: Dinner under the stars
program.description: A Moroccan dinner of harira soup, salads, chicken or beef tagine and seasonal fruit, served in the tents or outside by the fire.

program.title: Music around the fire
program.description: Local musicians play Berber and Gnawa music around the campfire after dinner.

program.title: Return to Marrakech
program.description: Drive back to Marrakech, about 45 minutes, with drop-off at your accommodation.

goodToKnow: Bring a warm layer. The desert cools quickly after sunset, even in summer, and winter evenings can be cold.
Wear closed shoes. The ground is stony.
Pickup time changes through the year with the sunset. We confirm the exact time the day before.
Vegetarian, vegan and other diets can be prepared if you tell us when booking.
Agafay is a stone desert without dunes. If golden dunes matter to you, look at our Merzouga desert tours.

faqs.question: How far is the Agafay Desert from Marrakech?
faqs.answer: The Agafay Desert is about 40 km southwest of Marrakech, around 45 minutes by car. The whole excursion lasts about 6 hours.

faqs.question: Does Agafay have sand dunes?
faqs.answer: No. Agafay is a stone desert of bare, pale hills. It does not have the golden dunes of the Sahara, which are a 9 to 10 hour drive away in Merzouga. Agafay gives you desert scenery, silence and sunset views in one evening.

faqs.question: What time does the Agafay sunset tour start and finish?
faqs.answer: Pickup is between 15:00 and 17:00 depending on the season, so you reach camp before sunset. You are back in Marrakech between 21:30 and 22:30.

faqs.question: Can I add quad biking to the Agafay tour?
faqs.answer: Yes. Quad biking or a buggy ride can be added before sunset for an extra fee. Let us know when booking so the timing works.

faqs.question: Is the Agafay tour suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Yes. Children can ride camels with an adult nearby, and the dinner can be adjusted for younger eaters. The evening is short enough for most families.
